defs.def: medical treatment of injuries or diseases that involves cutting open a person's body and often removing or replacing some parts; the branch of medicine connected with this treatment 外科手术；外科学

ex.s: At age 12, Jane was diagnosed with a rare and deadly cancer, and was informed that high-risk surgery was her only chance of getting better.
ex.t: 12岁时,简被诊断患有罕见的致命癌症,并被告知高风险手术是她唯一能够好转的机会.

ex.s: Jane received the surgery, and things got extremely hard during the two-year treatment that followed – she couldn’t even remember how many times she was rushed to the ICU.
ex.t: Jane接受了手术, 接下来的两年治疗中, 事情变得极为艰难 — — 她甚至不记得自己被送往重症监护室的几次。

ex.s: Prior to this, if a Tanzanian had a heart condition and needed surgery, they would have to go abroad.
ex.t: 在此之前,如果坦桑尼亚人有心脏病,需要手术,他们就必须出国。

ex.s: One of the most stressful days of Susan McFrederick's life was watching her son get wheeled away for surgery hours after he was born in 2011.
ex.t: 苏珊·麦克弗雷德里克一生中最紧张的日子之一，是2011年她儿子出生几小时后被推进手术室。

ex.s: She’d been struggling with eating disorders and health issues, which ___43___ led her to getting surgery.
When she was 50, she survived an emergency surgery.
ex.t: 她50岁时，挺过了一场紧急手术。

ex.s: The smiles took everyone's attention from the surgery.
ex.t: 微笑把每个人的注意力从手术上移开。

ex.s: As a physician during the Han Dynasty, Hua Tuo is often credited with being the first in China to use anesthesia during surgery.
ex.t: 作为汉朝时期的医生,华图经常被誉为是中国第一个在外科手术中使用麻醉药的.

ex.s: Every single member of the team gave their all to the fight, including Hui Ruoqi who had had heart surgery less than five months previously.
ex.t: 球队每个队员都全心全意投入战斗,包括5个月前做过心脏手术的惠若琪.

defs.def: the time during which a doctor, dentist or vet is available to see patients 应诊时间
a place where a doctor, dentist or vet sees patients 诊室；门诊处
a time when people can meet their Member of Parliament to ask questions and get help （议员的）接待时间
